dedupe_keys.name: e prostor slovenian geodetic data portal

description: e-Prostor (Slovenian geodetic data portal) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia (GURS). The portal distributes the real property cadastre (parcels and buildings), the spatial units and address registers, the cadastre of economic public infrastructure, the state topographic system and boundary records, and property market records; free public access goes through WMS, WFS, WMTS, OGC API Features and REST services, while personal data need a registered account with a digital certificate. Coverage: Slovenia. Formats and interfaces named: WMS, WFS, API. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: general conditions for the use of geodetic data apply; no licence type named on the page. Caveats: the page names no licence type or update dates, market and valuation data are not open, and hazard layers are not listed; parts of the data are also catalogued as single records. It can support asset location and utility network context for infrastructure studies in Slovenia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
